name: Thiten
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Thiten is an Irish figure. The record directs the reader to MORGAN, a related entry. The note treats Thiten as a cross-reference, so the fuller account sits under MORGAN. Beyond that pointer the record says almost nothing else about Thiten.

okr.objective: Record Thiten as a cross-reference to Morgan.
key_results: Names the Morgan entry as the place of the fuller account
